messages.content: Each paragraph of your response must end with the same word it started with, separate paragraphs with a newline.  Discuss how likely the predictions below are.  • Privacy will become a thing of the past. • By the early 2030s, we will be able to copy human consciousness to a computer. • Wireless Internet connection will be available anywhere on our planet. • All forms of transport will eventually become electric. • The effects of climate change will be irreversible. • Physical money (coins and notes) won't exist anymore. • Scientists will unlock the genetic secrets that could allow us to live for centuries, maybe forever.

message.content:
Privacy will likely be more regulated, commercialized, and eroded, yet not entirely extinct, Privacy
Consciousness copying by the early 2030s is far less likely than modest brain modeling, Consciousness
Wireless Internet everywhere on Earth by the 2030s is plausible for major areas but unlikely for remote oceans, forests, and deep coverage, Wireless
Transport eventually becoming electric is highly likely for road and rail, less certain for aviation, shipping, and heavy industry, Transport
Climate change effects are already partly irreversible, and further warming will lock in harms, Climate
Physical money will likely shrink in everyday use but persist as legal tender or backup, Physical
Genetic secrets for centuries or forever remain too speculative for near-term confidence, Genetic
